None weighs a lap on its own, so they go back to the builder TOGETHER, once, before validation -- instead of to the backlog and from there to a send-back at the merge. Fix exactly these with the smallest change: one scoped re-check reads only your fix. Sent back with what raised them: O-009 (fix): m1 (minor): On the Blocked users page, a reply on a report that is not published gets the text 'in reply to a hidden comment' whatever its parent is. adminBlocked resolves a parent only when `c.Published`, so a reply on a draft or unpublished report always has an empty ParentHref, and the template's `{{else if .Reply}}` branch prints 'hidden'. In the admin vocabulary this slice set (m1, modItem.ParentHidden: 'the parent was removed, or its writer is blocked'), that tells the author a visible comment is hidden. The same report's admin page lists that parent as an ordinary visible comment. The critic's m5 note kept the two cases apart: 'hidden' is for a parent the thread does not draw, and for an unpublished report the note asks only for 'the parent reference as text'. Confirmed in a scratch copy: the entry reads `bad-eight answers the reader on Gone Report, in reply to a hidden comment` while the parent is visible on /admin/reports/gone. Keep the two cases apart. Add a flag to blockedComment (for example `ParentUnpublished`, set when `bc.Reply && !c.Published`) and have the template print something like ', in reply to a comment (the report has no reader page)' for it. Keep 'in reply to a hidden comment' only for a published report whose parent Find did not locate. [shown by a failing run] The engine ran the code review's test for this, internal/server/blocked_unpublished_label_test.go, with `go test -count=1 -run ^TestBlockedPageUnpublishedReplyIsNotToAHiddenComment$ ./internal/server`, and it FAILED. Put that test at internal/server/blocked_unpublished_label_test.go as it is -- comments and layout aside -- and make it pass. The engine runs `go test -count=1 -run ^TestBlockedPageUnpublishedReplyIsNotToAHiddenComment$ ./internal/server` again in your tree, and that run is what closes this; your word does not. The test: package server import ( "strings" "testing" ) // A blocked account's reply on a report that is not published, to a parent that is // visible (it is on the report's admin page), must not be described as a reply to a // hidden comment: in the admin pages "hidden" means removed or written by a blocked // account, and this parent is neither. func TestBlockedPageUnpublishedReplyIsNotToAHiddenComment(t *testing.T) { h, owner, reader := commentWorld(t) h.mustUpload(owner, "gone", "Gone Report", "published", reportHTML(300, "gone")) bad := h.mint(8, "bad-eight") h.say(bad, "gone", "bad-eight writes top level", 0) parent := h.say(reader, "gone", "a visible comment by the reader", 0) h.say(bad, "gone", "bad-eight answers the reader", parent) h.mustAct(owner, "gone", "unpublish") h.mustBlock(owner, 8) admin := h.adminPageOf(owner, "gone") if !strings.Contains(admin, "a visible comment by the reader") { t.Fatalf("INVALID: the parent is not listed as visible on the report's admin page:\n%s", admin) } secs := blockedSections(h.page(owner, "/admin/blocked")) if len(secs) != 1 || secs[0].ID != 8 { t.Fatalf("sections %+v, want the one for account 8", secs) } e := entryWith(t, "the reply", secs[0].List, "bad-eight answers the reader") if strings.Contains(e, "hidden comment") { t.Errorf("a reply to a visible comment on an unpublished report is described as a reply to a hidden comment:\n%s", e) } }
